mapper.select: SELECT yyyymm, 자재명 AS 품명, 자재번호 AS 품번, 규격, 품목자산분류, 자재대분류 AS 대분류, 자재중분류 AS 중분류, 자재소분류 AS 소분류, 기준단위 AS 단위, NULL AS 자재구분, 중요도, 관리부서 AS 부서, NULL AS 처리, NULL AS 분류, NULL AS 표준원가, 대표자재 AS 대표품번, BOM등록 AS BOM유무, NULL AS 완제품소요량, [Lot 관리] AS Lot관리, [Serial 관리] AS Serial관리, NULL AS 외주관리여부, NULL AS 한글규격, 유통기간 AS 유효기간, NULL AS 색상, NULL AS 기본단가처리, 기본구매처 AS 구매거래처, NULL AS 인증규격, MAT_GRP_1, MAT_GRP_2 FROM DOI_VN_MATERIAL WHERE yyyymm = #{yyyymm} ORDER BY 품명

SELECT SMAssetGrpName AS 재고자산종류, WHName AS 창고, SMWHKindName AS 창고구분, AssetName AS 품목자산분류, ItemClassLName AS 품목대분류, ItemClassMName AS 품목중분류, ItemClassSName AS 품목소분류, ItemName AS 품명, ItemNo AS 품번, Spec AS 규격, UnitName AS 단위, SMStatusName AS 품목상태, TRY_CONVERT(numeric(18,3), PrevQty) AS 이월수량, TRY_CONVERT(numeric(18,3), InQty) AS 입고수량, TRY_CONVERT(numeric(18,3), OutQty) AS 출고수량, TRY_CONVERT(numeric(18,3), StockQty) AS 재고수량 FROM DOI_VN_IF_WH_STOCK_SUM WHERE SITE = N'VN' ORDER BY WHName, ItemNo

SELECT BizUnitName AS 사업부문, AssetName AS 품목자산분류, SMAssetGrpName AS 재고자산종류, ItemClassLName AS 품목대분류, ItemClassMName AS 품목중분류, ItemClassSName AS 품목소분류, ItemName AS 품명, ItemNo AS 품번, Spec AS 규격, UnitName AS 단위, SMStatusName AS 품목상태, PrevQty AS 이월수량, InQty AS 입고수량, OutQty AS 출고수량, StockQty AS 재고수량 FROM DOI_VN_IF_BIZ_STOCK_SUM WHERE SITE = N'VN' ORDER BY ItemNo

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO DOI_VN_MATERIAL (품명, 품번, 규격, 품목자산분류, 대분류, 중분류, 소분류, 단위, 자재구분, 중요도, 부서, 처리, 분류, 표준원가, 대표품번, BOM유무, 완제품소요량, Lot관리, Serial관리, 외주관리여부, 한글규격, 유효기간, 색상, 기본단가처리, 구매거래처, 인증규격, MAT_GRP_1, MAT_GRP_2, yyyymm, edit_user, edit_date) VALUES (#{item.field1}, #{item.field2}, #{item.field3}, #{item.field4}, #{item.field5}, #{item.field6}, #{item.field7}, #{item.field8}, #{item.field9}, #{item.field10}, #{item.field11}, #{item.field12}, #{item.field13}, #{item.field14}, #{item.field15}, #{item.field16}, #{item.field17}, #{item.field18}, #{item.field19}, #{item.field20}, #{item.field21}, #{item.field22}, #{item.field23}, #{item.field24}, #{item.field25}, #{item.field26}, #{item.field27}, #{item.field28}, #{item.field29}, #{item.editUser}, GETDATE())
